d: The world is making big climate promises, but is anyone delivering? At COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, world leaders face mounting pressure as emissions rise, extreme weather intensifies and the 1.5C target slips further out of reach. From Türkiye's controversial 35-by-35 electrification proposal and the battle over climate finance to Greta Thunberg's scathing criticism of world leaders, the summit faces tough questions. Meanwhile, a new carbon market partnership and Britain's climate security push add fresh dimensions to the debate. Will COP31 deliver real action or another round of empty…
